cases.question: Why did expenses stay flat this quarter?
cases.answer: Expenses stayed flat because headcount was stable—no net new hires were made in engineering, sales, or other teams—so payroll and related costs did not increase.

cases.question: Did anything go wrong security-wise recently?
cases.answer: Yes. In early September a misconfigured access‑control rule briefly exposed a subset of internal analytics dashboards without authentication for about 40 minutes; the issue was detected by automated monitoring, rolled back, and an automated pre‑deploy check was added afterward. No other security incidents meeting the internal disclosure threshold occurred during the quarter.
